intent: PSI-024: Implement Notification center and live bell.
summary: Built mobile-first notifications page (/dashboard/notifications) with time-grouped notifications (Today/Earlier), category filters, mark read, mark all read, quick shortcuts to Agenda/Mail/Kanban, and header bell component with live Supabase Realtime CDC subscription. Verified with tsc, oxlint, and next build.

Grouped list, category select filter, shortcuts bar

decisions.decision: Use Supabase Realtime postgres_changes filter user_id=eq.{userId}
